capabilities: Build a modular dashboard with graph, note, browser, terminal, and ticket boxes
Create numbered project tickets with auto-generated frontmatter
Style Graph View node size, color, legend, and edges from frontmatter
Sync folder notes and hybrid link properties between sibling notes
Add reading-view helpers like table formulas, callout favicons, and sandboxed HTML embeds
extras: Desktop only because browser and terminal boxes use Electron APIs; requires the core Web Viewer plugin for browser boxes; listing marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; documented only as a feature list with installation instructions, no usage examples.
problem: Obsidian has no single configurable dashboard where graph, embedded web pages, notes, a terminal, and project tickets live together, and Graph View cannot be styled from frontmatter.
summary: Modular dashboard toolkit that arranges graph, note, browser, and terminal boxes, plus tickets, folder notes, and Graph View styling extensions.
